description: A low frequency oscillator with a shaped waveform, a built-in envelope and voltage control over its speed and level

params.text: Sets the speed of the oscillator within the band picked by the switch below it
Picks the band the speed knob works in: Low, Audio or Lower
Attenuates the pitch input before it reaches the oscillator
Picks the waveform: Triangle, Square or Saw
Bends the waveform: None leaves it as it is, Curve Out bulges it outwards and Curve In hollows it
Picks how the output swings around zero: Inverted, Non-Inverted or Unipolar
Sets how long the envelope holds after a gate arrives, with the envelope following the gate when it is at zero
Sets how long the envelope takes to fall away
Sets how much the envelope opens or closes the oscillator's level, marked -10 to +10
Sets how much the envelope speeds the oscillator up or slows it down, marked -10 to +10
Sets the output level of the oscillator

inputs.text: Moves the speed of the oscillator at a volt per octave, scaled by the attenuation knob beside it
A gate here starts the envelope

outputs.text: The oscillator at the level, shape and polarity set on the panel
